text:
jordan-support: Escalation from AcmeCorp — multiple users report 500s on /v1/deploy after SSO deprovision. Customer asks for audit logs + KMS evidence for retention/compliance. Repro steps and logs below. Looping in eng-identity + security.

jordan-support: Repro steps (from customer):
```
1) Deprovision user via SCIM -> status 204
2) Immediately call /v1/deploy with that user's token
3) Response: intermittent 500, sometimes 403
Headers captured: x-request-id: 8a7f3c2e, tenant: acme-prod
```

michael-eng-identity: Looking now. Can you attach the x-request-id samples and obfuscated headers? Need to trace through RBAC cache + KMS call.

jordan-support: Sample server log (obfuscated):
```
[2024-02-24T14:12:31Z] tenant=acme-prod x-request-id=8a7f3c2e user=joe.doe@acme SSO=SCIM_deprov
ERROR: handler.deploy failed: rpc: KMS DecryptFailed key_id=proj-******** code=4002
stack: 
  /srv/runtime/kms_client.go:142 -> Decrypt
  /srv/runtime/handler/deploy.go:58 -> HandleDeploy
```

alina-security: If DecryptFailed happened while deprovisioning, we need to verify whether any key rotations/deletions overlapped. Customer specifically asked for: 1) audit timeline for that tenant, 2) list of KMS access attempts (successful + failed), 3) confirmation no plaintext left accessible. @audit-bot can you export the tenant's audit slice?

audit-bot: Audit export queued. Link: s3://redwood-exports/acme/2024-02-24/deprov-1708739402.tar.gz. Retention policy: 365 days. Export contains: auth_events.json, scim_jobs.json, kms_access.log (redacted), api_traces.json.

michael-eng-identity: Reproduced locally by forcing SCIM tombstone then hitting deploy. Observed: token validation -> RBAC cache lookup -> allowed by cache (stale) -> service attempts to decrypt tenant-specific model key -> KMS returns DecryptFailed for rotated key -> runtime surfaces 500 instead of mapping to 403. Hypothesis: race between SCIM sync (tombstone) and RBAC cache TTL + missing guard on KMS errors. Plan: add guard so DecryptFailed -> return 403 + user-facing message, and trigger immediate SCIM cache invalidation for tenant on deprov events.

ops-oncall: Rollback/fallback plan if customer sees spike: 1) set tenant to fallback-readonly via console (prevents deploys), 2) force SCIM full sync for acme-prod, 3) if needed, manual fallback KMS key (requires security approval). We'll keep pager in place until bundle delivered.

jordan-support: Customer wants written evidence that no data was exfiltrated. Security: which logs show key usage vs attempted decrypt failures vs plaintext access? Need a short list we can send.

alina-security: We can provide: 1) kms_access.log showing decrypt_attempts with key_id and result (Success/DecryptFailed), 2) api_traces.json showing request ids + affected endpoints, 3) scim_jobs.json with timestamps for deprov propagation, 4) signed export bundle (S3 link above) + hash. We'll redact key material. Need devs to annotate which DecryptFailed entries correspond to tenant and time range.

michael-eng-identity: Added the SCIM job timestamps: last full sync for acme-prod: 2024-02-24T14:10:12Z, incremental job at 2024-02-24T14:11:59Z. KMS key metadata: last rotation event for tenant key proj-********: 2024-02-24T13:59:03Z (rotation completed). SAML assertion sample (obfuscated):
```
<saml:Assertion id="_abc" IssueInstant="2024-02-24T14:11:50Z">
  Subject: joe.doe@acme
  Conditions NotOnOrAfter: 2024-02-24T14:21:50Z
</saml:Assertion>
```
Note: assertion timestamp is between rotation and deprov.

jordan-support: Great — prepping an update to Acme legal & SecOps. ETA ~2h for initial evidence bundle + recommended mitigations. Will post customer update once we have signed export and the dev annotation. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Marking incident P2 for tracking. I'll open a short incident doc with timeline and link to export.

jordan-support: Thanks team — looping back with customer now.
